    Coherent coefficients for the central Figure-14 chain #

    The repeated-object core of Figure 14 is

    D --delta--> C --lambda--> D --delta--> C.

    If sigma = lambda * delta is a local radical parameter and the threefold composite survives, the five path lines delta, lambda, sigma, rho = delta * lambda, and delta * lambda * delta admit compatible scalar coefficients. This is the degree-one analogue of the Figure-13 coefficient construction; importantly, it does not require sigma^2 to survive.

      A surviving Figure-14 central chain carries coherent coefficients. The middle arrow needs transit only for transporting the opposite cycle; its ordinary endpoint coefficient is automatically compatible with both split residue maps.

        Extend prescribed, already normalized arrow coefficients across a directed length-two arm. This form is needed in Figure 14 because the two arms share their occurrence of delta with the central alternating chain, so the arrow coefficient must be literally the same functional in all three places.

        Full, correctly oriented arms admit coherent coefficients as soon as no invertible twist kills the displayed length-two composite.
